correctness.rationale: Exact definition and exhaustive reconstruction: 720 cyclic orders over 35 increasing triples. Seven explicit fixed queries have 128 certified witnesses; symmetry sends any one query to triple (0,1,2), and all its 8-query extensions are excluded by complete bitmask search whose only pruning criterion is necessary 2^(8-k) witnesses per cell. Explicit full tree has 511 internal queries and 512 distinct depth-nine witnesses. Depth ten requires 1024>720 hypotheses; smaller sizes 3..6 have fixed shattered supports saturating their information bounds. Standalone checker completed successfully.
